comments: c32a5e70: This routine is for generating operational, interim, and discharge summary reports.
4e918839: If multiple divisions are present, allow selection.
ba5b32bb: If a single division, automatically select the first one.
eb23d0bd: Execute the selected report type.
63631bf7: Prompt for date range for the report.
6ab1d8e7: Set filter for specific summary types only.
e5c5ac91: Prompt user to select summary types to include in the report.
fc928805: Notify user about the required column width for the report output.
e191144e: Set the report date to the current date and time.
d716fabb: Prepare the environment for the report execution and start the report.
e3024709: Exit the routine.
4cb56e0b: Initialize variables and start processing records.
9d5145a1: If operational or both operational and discharge summaries are requested, proceed to the next routine for processing.
b703b32d: If only discharge summaries are requested, proceed to the specific routine for processing.
961bb1f8: Display message if no records match the criteria.
a66c7603: Exit the program.
9cb4e7c0: Calculate the total count of items.
5493fff8: Update total and over 30-day count for the division.
adda6316: Update physician total and over 30-day count for the division.
56bfadf4: Calculate and update physician totals.
f5430412: Calculate and update service totals.
f0e38ddc: Update service and specialty totals.
a030d84d: Exit the count routine.
51213538: Exclude records from divisions not selected by the user.
19f818e4: Exclude records not belonging to the user's division.
d16bf1d0: Exclude records if not marked as reviewed when required.
b5c89b56: Exclude records if looking for unreviewed and the record is reviewed.
4c9c9f30: Exclude discharge summaries not linked to a patient movement event.
167f0529: Set the field number for the service or physician based on the report type.
b35987f5: Exclude records not matching the specified summary types.
042d8adc: Exclude records from non-selected services.
f9a8bf2b: Exclude records from non-selected specialties.
14b06133: Exclude records from non-selected summary types.
c84af552: Exclude records outside the specified date range.
584b1336: Load the record for processing; skip if record is not valid.
b67bc0eb: Set division name, default to 'NOT SPECIFIED' if not found.
0e4d80b9: For service reports, trim the division name to fit the format.
c193154f: Retrieve patient name from the patient file.
8e7acced: For physician reports, set physician name and update utility global for report.
750e71ee: For service reports, set service and specialty names and update utility global for report.
62d51f96: Trim service, specialty, and patient names for service reports and update utility global.
0ba7fb44: Exit the check routine.
da0a2ea6: Aggregate totals for physician or service.
bda7c2ac: Update the physician total aggregates.
af28571e: Update the service total aggregates.
4e9eefd7: Exit the PC routine.
102e4cea: Update totals and over 30-day counts.
477d1f58: Exit the TOT routine.
2cbef471: Prompt for physician selection.
bea1dd8d: Exit the physician selection routine.
61d9a2ca: Prompt for service selection.
fb455f40: Prompt for specialty selection.
55a3b839: Exit the service and specialty selection routine.
